name: model3d-studio
description: AI 도면 기반 3D 모델링 웹서비스 — 모노레포 루트

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:worker
scripts.lint:worker: uv run --directory apps/worker ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/worker ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:web && pnpm run typecheck:worker
scripts.typecheck:worker: uv run --directory apps/worker mypy src tests
scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:worker
scripts.contracts:check: uv run --directory apps/worker m3d contracts check
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run build
